text:
elaine: Quick sync — Acme POC orderform OF-2026-0412 needs signature routing. Legal put MSA/DPA redlines, procurement requests PO# mapping + KMS addendum. Can someone handle routing? :wave:

devon_se: I can take routing. Do we have the signed MSA PDF or just redline docx?

elaine: Just redline docx from Matt. Link: https://files.redwood/acme/redline-msadpa.docx

matt_legal: That's mine — highlighted the DPA subproc clause and SLA uptime target (99.5%). We need engineering to confirm KMS support for customer-managed keys for gov region.

sara_fin: Finance flagged net30 vs net45 on the PO. Customer expects net45 but sales was ok with net30 for POC credits. Need confirmation before signature.

laura_procurement: Also need vendor tax form + remit address on the orderform, otherwise PO creation stalls in their ERP.

devon_se: KMS-wise we support CMEK in prod but for private deployments we need a ticket. @matt_legal is that acceptable as a conditional clause? Could add a timeline: 'CMEK enablement within 30 days of go-live'.

matt_legal: Yes, add that clause. Also propose adding fallback: 'If CMEK is not available, keys remain with Redwood until customer enablement'.

elaine: Ok agreed. @sara_fin can we accept net45 for the POC only and then net30 for the long-term contract?

sara_fin: Yes — finance approves net45 limited to POC order OF-2026-0412. Need exec email confirmation from customer. I can draft the billing note.

devon_se: I'll prepare a signature routing envelope: DocuSign envelope id: env-87123. Will include MSA (redline accepted), DPA with subproc addendum, PO mapped to OF-2026-0412, and KMS addendum. ETA to send: 2 hours.

docs_bot: deploy-bot: DocuSign envelope env-87123 queued; routing: elaine -> customer-signer -> matt_legal -> laura_procurement. Tracking link: https://docusign/redwood/env-87123

elaine: Perfect. If customer countersigns with additional SLA tweaks we'll escalate to legal. Thanks team :thumbsup:
